name: Onix Apparel Shopping Concierge
description: Enterprise-grade shopping and styling assistant for Onix Apparel. Capable of semantic catalog search, real-time facet filtering, client cart manipulation, and brand policy grounding (shipping, returns, sizing).

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search clothing and fine jewelry catalog with semantic query matching, category filters, and price ranges.

query.description: Free text query, e.g. 'black leather jacket' or 'gold ring'

size.description: Clothing or accessory size (e.g. S, M, L, XL, One Size)

color.description: Color name (e.g. Onyx Black, Warm Cream)

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Client action tool to add an item directly to the shopper's active cart.

tools.name: view_product
tools.description: Opens the high-resolution Quick View detail modal on the shopper's screen.

tools.name: navigate_collection
tools.description: Directs the customer's browser to a specific fashion department or sale collection.

tools.name: get_customer_care_policy
tools.description: Retrieves official brand policies for shipping, returns, sizing, and client services.
